body:
### Need
Test reach (D-214) stops at the project edge, so a change to a shared project never runs the tests of projects that use it. See task:b0fadf061f7d551a, note 2.

### Required behavior
1. A test in a dependent project (one depending on the changed project by path, as in task:6c8565814de1fc7c) counts as changed when the reach hash of anything it can run in the shared project changed, the same rule D-214 applies inside one project.
2. `test` without `--all` in a task runs those dependent tests too, and reports them under their project.
3. Tests whose reach didn't change still don't run.

### Acceptance
- Changing a components symbol that a frontend test reaches runs that frontend test; changing one it doesn't reach doesn't.

### Left out
- Any change to which tests count as reaching processes, network or foreign code.
- Amends D-214; record the amendment.
title: test: reach crosses into dependent projects
